verdict.rationale: Skyvern's docs show automations that run on their own. Its AI agents navigate unseen sites and complete multi-step tasks from a natural-language goal via API or SDK (skyvern-docs-17, skyvern-gh-1, skyvern-docs-18), and you can build reusable workflows visually (skyvern-docs-6). Runs handle logins, 2FA and CAPTCHAs without intervention (skyvern-docs-8, skyvern-docs-9), can be triggered through REST or Zapier (skyvern-docs-1, skyvern-docs-16), and record artifacts for later review (skyvern-docs-11). A hands-on report shows runs can fail off the happy path (skyvern-comm-2), so autonomous reliability is not guaranteed. Missing for 10: explicit scheduling/cron or background-trigger documentation, and independent corroboration of reliable unattended runs.
